text:
Liam: FYI - Astra-lite q5 quant bringup showing weird detok behavior for CJK and RTL. quick hits: ZWJ dropped in zh emoji clusters, extra space before Japanese fullstop, and Arabic closing punctuation separated. Repro + snippets below. @Ayako @Rachid can you triage?

Ayako: thx. do you have a minimal repro command?

Liam: yep, ran a tiny roundtrip eval locally:
```bash
python -m evals.roundtrip \
  --model=astra-lite --quant=q5 --n=100 \
  --locales=ja,zh,ar --detok=auto \
  --out=/tmp/astra_q5_roundtrip.jsonl
```

Liam: example diffs (detoked strings):
- baseline (float) ja: "\u306b\u884c\u3063\u305f\u3002"
- quant q5 detok: "\u306b\u884c\u3063\u305f  \u3002"  <-- extra space before punctuation

- baseline zh: "\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u6b22"
- quant q5: "\ud83d\ude0a  \u6b22"  <-- ZWJ removed, gap inserted

- baseline ar: "مرحبا، كيف حالك؟"
- quant q5: "مرحبا ، كيف حالك ؟"  <-- spaced comma / question-mark

Sam: interesting. tokenizer mismatch or detok normalization? have we changed vocab serialization recently?

Ayako: we merged tokenizer loader tweak (normalize_zws) two weeks ago (PR #3599). float canaries pulled new tokenizer, but some quant artifacts were failing to pick the same serialized file in the image build. possible mismatch.

Rachid: ops-bot kicking off a focused canary with pinned tokenizer v2026-03-01 and explicit detok modes.

ops-bot: Canary queued: canary/4980012345-1 (astra-lite q5)  — 40 samples ja/zh/ar. expect ~12m.

Rachid: also dumping raw token ids for failing samples (byte-level) so we can compare boundaries. please attach ids in your run outputs.

Liam: i ran a quick shot with `--detok=legacy` and pinned tokenizer v2026-03-01. still saw ja spacing but ZWJ seemed preserved in a handful of zh samples. odd. log excerpt:
```
INFO: tokenizer=v2026-03-01 loaded
DEBUG: sample[7] locale=zh input="\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u6b22" detok="\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u6b22" tokens=[1283,452,90]
DEBUG: sample[19] locale=ja input="\u6211\u53bb\u6771\u4eac\u3002" detok="\u6211\u53bb\u6771\u4eac  \u3002" tokens=[204,789,12,999]
```

Ayako: this suggests two separate root causes: 1) some images are loading older tokenizers (ZWJ), 2) the detok spacing is applied downstream (post-detok normalization) possibly inside the quant-fastpath.

Sam: i can spin up a debug build that logs the detok normalization step for quant kernels (fastpath). will instrument and run a 20-sample smoke.

Rachid: mitigation idea: temporary routing for ja/zh/ar -> route 90% to float for now and keep 10% on quant for continued telemetry. we should auto-revert when metrics stable.

Liam: metrics from initial 100-sample run: ja->en BLEU -1.8, zh->en BLEU -0.9, ar->en BLEU -4.2 (rtl punctuation-heavy subset). chrF changes smaller but COMET flagged more semantic degradation for arabic.

Ayako: we should also add a CI detok regression test that decodes sample sets and asserts ZWJ presence for emoji glue cases. minimal golden set. i'll open a ticket.

Sam: debug build done, posting small log after run.

Sam: debug output snippet:
```text
DETOK-NORM[quant-fastpath]: step=trim_ws_after_token merge_punct=false norm_zwsp=true
SAMPLE 5: raw_ids=[101,202,303] pre_detok="..." post_detok="...  。"
```

Liam: aha — `merge_punct=false` on the quant-fastpath. that flag should be consistent with float. where is it configured?

Ayako: it's in the runtime config defaults. looks like quant images ship an older runtime config blob (we reverted a change accidentally in image bake on Mar 9). will sync config blobs across builds.

Rachid: plan of action: 1) sync runtime config in quant images (Ayako) 2) pin tokenizer serialization in quant CI and rebuild (Ayako + Sam) 3) temporary routing policy (Rachid) 4) add detok golden tests to CI (Liam).

Liam: timeline?

Ayako: i can push config fix + rebuild in ~4h.

Sam: i will run instrumented canary once rebuild is up.

Rachid: i'll prepare the routing change and monitor metrics, hold for +1 from Eng Leads.

Liam: thanks team. will post follow-up here with the 4h results. cc: @security if we end up doing hotfix images. :thumbsup:
